correctness.rationale: PASS: A commuting idempotent is a projection onto an ordered pair of invariant module summands for F_q[t]/(t^a)^m plus F_q[t]/(t^b)^m. Their automorphism group cardinality is q^(a x²+2a xy+b y²) times Phi_x(q) Phi_y(q), from Hom dimensions and reduction modulo t. The transitive automorphism action has stabilizer Aut(image) x Aut(kernel), yielding every exact profile count. Completing the exponent gives -2a(r+s-m)²-2(b-a)(s-m/2)²; the Phi factors tend uniformly to their nonzero Euler-product limits on growing central boxes while Gaussian tails are exponentially small. Thus the parity-dependent product-theta limit and total-variation estimate follow; finite counts do not establish it. Independently recalculated the nine (r,s) exact counts for q=2,a=1,b=2,m=2: [1,384,256,96,2304,96,256,384,1], sum 3778; approximate TV distances at m=6,7,10,11 were respectively .03311,.02260,.00803,.00555.
